scope: parseDecimal with Java DecimalFormat patterns and defaults, random(), and XPath arithmetic over empty members

native.toolchain: Linux MxBuild portable app and Mendix Runtime via script/oql_native_oracle (HSQLDB)

random.type: Decimal from the shortest double representation

native.database_limit: [Amount = 2 - -0.5] fails in HSQLDB with numeric value out of range and is not a case

native_semantics: parse stops at the first character that does not belong to the number and ignores the rest
grouping separators are accepted anywhere only when the pattern groups
prefixes and suffixes must match; percent and per mille divide the value
a plus sign or leading space fails; the default is returned when given, otherwise the call fails
XPath integer division truncates; arithmetic over an empty member is NULL and never compares true
fixed: parseDecimal rejected a pattern argument and the three-argument form
XPath arithmetic over an empty member raised an error
Long values beyond 2**53 - 1 lost precision in the browser
